reviews.title: It’s basically garbage
reviews.text:
Because I can use this without creating an account, 2 stars. Aside from that, this app pretty much sucks. 

The sleep data is just made up. I was awake and active, took a few walks, and the data shows no awake time and 30/30/30 in the sleep cycles … when I was not sleeping. 

The activities logged from my watch don’t sync to health or fitness, I have to start the activity in one of those apps and it will sync to very fit, but that defeats the purpose, doesn’t it.

reviews.title: It actually works pretty well
reviews.text:
I see a lot of reviews complaining, and I haven’t had any of those issues. It works just fine for me. Some of the data I don’t really trust - like the stress levels. Sleep is spot on, heart rate seems pretty close, I have crippling anxiety so my heart rate is faster than a normal person’s. 

You can definitely tell it’s translated from Chinese, and some of the grammatical errors in the app are silly and made me laugh, it’s not a problem though, besides the fact that China is probably watching me now.

Update: I see some people in the reviews here complaining about things that are their fault, 🤦‍♀️

If your screen is turning off too fast, have you considered, you know maybe going into the settings and making it higher? 

The guy that said it needs charged daily is a liar. Mine is currently at 25% and the last charge was ELEVEN days ago!

A lot of these negative reviews are from foolish people having issues that are their fault!

reviews.title: The ads have to go
reviews.text: This app was great until these terrible ads started popping up. They force you to close them before you can see or do anything, which makes the app incredibly frustrating to use. The ads are also spammy - one even tried to tell me that my phone had been hacked. I understand the need for ads, but intrusive and misleading ads like these are enough to make me stop using the app.

reviews.title: Doesn’t keep workout logs
reviews.text: I really like the watch and all the different utilities and I got it specifically for workouts. However I will go for a run and it will show it in the log for the day but then a day or two later the log of my run disappears. It doesn’t always happen every but it happens frequently so there are huge gaps in my run log and it would be extremely helpful if I could look back on them to see how I am progressing. I’ve had to start using a different app for tracking on top of this one just so I can see my time during the run which shouldn’t be the case. It also doesn’t track distances consistently, I run the same loop every time but I hit mile markers at different points every time. Other than that I love the screen saver options and the heart rate monitor on my runs so I can see if my effort is becoming more efficient. I get it’s a $35 watch so you get what you get but this is clearly a software issue with the app. Thank you!
